title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler of warmth, and Psalm 23 is Heavenly Father's tenderness: green pastures, still waters, a restored soul, a table set, and goodness and mercy following all the days.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because Willow loves to help everyone feel safe and cared for. In Willow’s world today: Willow’s little brother woke up scared from a bad dream. Willow did not laugh at him. She brought him a cup of water, tucked his blanket up to his chin, and sat right beside his bed until his breathing went slow and soft. “I’m right here,” she whispered. Just like David sang that Heavenly Father is a shepherd who stays close in the dark valley, Willow learned that staying near someone who is scared is one of the warmest hugs of all.
